canada.title: Trump says he expects trade war with Canada to end 'pretty soon'
canada.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump says he expects his ever-evolving trade war with Canada to end “pretty soon.”

canada.title: Scarce St. John River salmon population will continue getting support from DFO facility
canada.summary: The Department of Fisheries and Oceans has reversed its decision to cut a program that First Nations believe helps keep the outer Bay of Fundy Atlantic salmon population alive in the St. John River system.

canada.title: Liberals link PC leader to former premier — despite their public feud
canada.summary: It didn’t take long for Premier Susan Holt’s Liberals to find their rhetorical footing against new Progressive Conservative Leader Daniel Allain.

canada.title: No offshore wind call for bids until consultation with Mi’kmaq is complete: regulator
canada.summary: Consultation with Mi’kmaw groups on the topic of offshore wind farms has begun, and the regulator says it will not launch a call for bids for seabed licences until the process is complete.

canada.title: Former interim PC leader backs Becky Druhan's bid for N.S. Liberal leadership
canada.summary: Former Progressive Conservative interim leader Karla MacFarlane is backing Becky Druhan to be the next leader of the Nova Scotia Liberal Party.

canada.title: Reports show staffing shortages, training lapses and care failures in N.L. group homes
canada.summary: Group homes and residential care placements ensure children without a home have somewhere to live, and ideally, to thrive. A CBC News investigation has found that's not always the case.

canada.title: St. John's man with disability could become homeless after losing support program
canada.summary: When Raylynn White was told her cousin "graduated," she didn’t celebrate. The news, given over the phone, meant her beloved relative Michael Morrison no longer qualifies for the Community Support Program facilitated by Newfoundland and Labrador Health Services.

canada.title: Doerkson won’t rule out shortened fall session after provincial election win
canada.summary: VICTORIA - B.C.'s newly minted Conservative government could take its seats in the legislature soon, but the premier-designate is not ruling out a shortened fall session.

canada.title: It's municipal election day in Windsor. Here's what you need to know
canada.summary: Windsor voters head to the polls Monday to choose their next mayor, city councillors and school trustees. And a new voting system is giving residents more flexibility in where they cast their ballots.

canada.title: Montreal wants rent control, mandatory registry. What would that look like?
canada.summary: The city of Montreal passed a motion asking the Quebec government to create a mandatory rent registry and to cap rent increases to inflation over a three-year average. Housing advocates are praising the move, but not everyone is on board.

canada.title: North Vancouver graduates-to-be have a night to remember as party boat gets stuck in the mud
canada.summary: About 150 Sutherland Secondary School students who were celebrating their graduating year were stranded for hours on Friday night after their party boat ran aground in the Burrard Inlet.
